apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Android package IDs (like com.whatsapp) or app names to search for. Package IDs (anything containing a dot) are used directly; names resolve to the top search result.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter Play Store country code (the `gl` parameter).

language.title: Language
language.description: Two-letter language code for review text and app metadata (the `hl` parameter).

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Maximum number of reviews to fetch per app, paginated in batches of 200.

sort.title: Sort order
sort.description: Review sort order. Google Play only exposes three orders: newest first, highest-rated first, or most relevant (Google's own relevance ranking, generally favors longer/more-helpful reviews).

includeAppInfo.title: Also output app metadata
includeAppInfo.description: Adds one record per app with name, developer, score, rating count, installs, price and current version.
